# Content Model and Build Guard Requirements Quality Checklist: Frame the Writing pages around Drift & Convergence

**Purpose**: Validate that the series, free-form topic and build-failure requirements are complete, unambiguous and consistent.
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Series Membership

- [x] CHK001 Is it unambiguous that series membership comes only from the `topics` list, with no new frontmatter field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Is the controlled list's exact membership (four topics plus two series) and the series flag defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK003 Is the unique-colour rule stated to cover series and ordinary topics together, with each assigned palette named? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010a]
- [x] CHK004 Is the requirement that a post still needs at least one topic reconciled with posts that carry only free-form topics? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Are the four post-to-series tag assignments specified by a stable identifier (slug), not only by title? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Both-Series Rejection

- [x] CHK006 Is the both-series failure message content defined (names the post and states the rule)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified whether a post naming one series twice is a both-series error or a duplicate-topic error? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 Is the failure required for drafts as well as visible posts? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK009 Is "fails the build" defined as a build-time schema error, consistent with the constitution's rule that invalid content fails with a clear error? [Consistency, Constitution §VI]

## Near-Miss Free-Form Ids

- [x] CHK010 Is edit distance defined precisely (Levenshtein, and whether transpositions count as one or two) so "within two letters" is testable? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Is the comparison set fixed to all six controlled ids, series included? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK012 Is the rule defined for short free-form ids where distance two matches many unrelated controlled ids? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK013 Is the tie rule defined when two controlled ids are equally near? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK014 Is there a defined escape for a genuine free-form topic that happens to be near a controlled id? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK015 Does the message requirement include the post name and the probable controlled id, in plain language? [Completeness, Spec §US2 AC4, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK016 Is the near-miss rule stated to apply to the spec's own example (`convergance`) and to ids differing only by case or separator? [Coverage, Spec §US2 AC4]

## Reserved Slugs

- [x] CHK017 Is the reserved-slug failure defined for both `drift` and `convergence`, and for the post's file name versus any slug override? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK018 Is the reason for reservation (collision with `/writing/{slug}/`) captured in the required error message? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK019 Are other reserved or colliding addresses (`all`, `topics`, paginated page numbers) addressed or explicitly out of scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK020 Is a free-form topic id such as `all` or `drift`-like values covered, given its page lives under `/writing/topics/{id}/`? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Free-Form Topics

- [x] CHK021 Is it specified that every free-form id used by any published post gets exactly one listing page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK022 Is the sentence-case label rule complete for digits, multiple hyphens and acronyms (for example `ai-ops`)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK023 Are the id format rules (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, at most 40, named once) stated with their error behaviour? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK024 Is the free-form banner content defined ("plain banner") with the heading and description it carries? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK025 Is it stated that free-form topics are excluded from the landing pill row and from series pages, and how they order relative to controlled topics on a card? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK026 Is the free-form topic page's pagination and empty-state behaviour stated as the same as controlled topic pages? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]

## Untagged Posts and Backward Compatibility

- [x] CHK027 Is "no warning about the missing series" stated so a silent build is a requirement, not an accident? [Clarity, Spec §US2 AC3]
- [x] CHK028 Is "looks the same as before" measurable, with the recolour of Agentic AI and Technology teams named as the only exception? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, §FR-010a]
- [x] CHK029 Are existing posts and the sample post required to remain valid under the new schema without edits other than FR-005? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK030 Is the feed's content for tagged versus untagged posts, including any category output, defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]

## Draft Handling and Ordering

- [x] CHK031 Is draft exclusion defined for series pages, landing lead, feed and free-form topic pages in production? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 Is marker ordering defined when a series and several topics are present, including order among topics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK033 Is the "main topic" for text-only card borders defined when a post has no series and several controlled topics? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
